UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and dashboard polling preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name of the authenticated user (1-80 chars).

activeDeviceId.description: ID of the currently selected Pi-hole device profile.

refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Live dashboard and query log polling interval in seconds (2-60).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

PiholeDeviceProfile.title: PiholeDeviceProfile
PiholeDeviceProfile.description: Remote or LAN Pi-hole server connection profile synced per user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Pi-hole server (1-255 chars).

port.description: TCP port for the Pi-hole web/API interface (1-65535).

apiVersion.description: Pi-hole API version (V6 REST API or V5 legacy api.php).

locationTag.description: Network tag such as Home LAN, WireGuard VPN, or Remote (0-40 chars).

notes.description: Optional notes about this Pi-hole node (0-240 chars).

hasStoredCredential.description: Indicates whether an encrypted local Pi-hole password/API token is stored on device.

lastConnectedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of last successful connection.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when device was added.

ManagementAuditLog.title: ManagementAuditLog
ManagementAuditLog.description: Immutable record of remote Pi-hole management actions performed by the user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

deviceId.description: Identifier of the target Pi-hole device profile.

deviceName.description: Snapshot name of the target Pi-hole device.

target.description: Domain, timer duration, or summary detail (0-255 chars).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile and active Pi-hole preferences.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Owner-only collection of configured Pi-hole server profiles.

/users/{userId}/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Owner-only immutable audit log of remote Pi-hole configuration changes.
